questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of inverse proportion?
choices: Number of workers and time to complete a job
Time taken for a journey and distance travelled at uniform speed
Area of land and crop harvested
Population of a country and area of land per person
questions.solution: The number of workers on a job and the time to complete the job are in inverse proportion because more workers mean less time to complete the job, and fewer workers mean more time. The other options do not show a relationship where one quantity increases while the other decreases proportionally.

questions.stem: If the number of winners increases, what happens to the prize money given to each winner?

questions.stem: If 6 pipes can fill a tank in 80 minutes, how long will it take 5 pipes to fill the same tank?
questions.solution: Since the number of pipes and the time taken are in inverse proportion, the product of the number of pipes and the time must remain constant. So, 6 × 80 = 5 × x. Solving for x, we get x = 96. Therefore, 5 pipes will take 96 minutes to fill the tank.

questions.stem: If a box of sweets is divided among 24 children, each gets 5 sweets. How many sweets would each child get if there were 20 children?
questions.solution: The total number of sweets is 24 × 5 = 120. If there are 20 children, each would get 120 ÷ 20 = 6 sweets. The other options are incorrect because they do not result from dividing 120 by 20.

questions.stem: In a hostel, 100 students have food for 20 days. If 25 more students join, how many days will the food last?

questions.stem: A map has a scale of 1:30,000,000. If two cities are 4 cm apart on the map, what is the actual distance between them?
questions.solution: The scale of the map is 1:30,000,000, meaning 1 cm on the map represents 30,000,000 cm in real life. Therefore, 4 cm on the map represents 4 × 30,000,000 cm = 120,000,000 cm = 1200 km. The other options result from incorrect unit conversions or calculations.

questions.stem: If 15 workers can build a wall in 48 hours, how many workers are needed to build the same wall in 30 hours?
questions.solution: The number of workers and the time taken to build the wall are in inverse proportion. So, 15 × 48 = x × 30. Solving for x, we get x = 24. Therefore, 24 workers are needed to build the wall in 30 hours.

questions.stem: If the price of a book increases from 40 to 50, the number of books that can be bought with 6000 decreases from 150 to 120. What is the relationship between the price of a book and the number of books that can be bought?
questions.solution: The relationship is inverse proportion because as the price of a book increases, the number of books that can be bought with a fixed amount of money decreases. This is confirmed by the fact that the product of price and quantity remains constant (40×150 = 50×120 = 6000). Direct proportion would mean both values increase together, which is not the case here. No proportion or cannot be determined are incorrect because the relationship is clearly defined by the constant product.

hi.stem: यदि किसी पुस्तक की कीमत 40 से बढ़कर 50 हो जाती है, तो 6000 में खरीदी जा सकने वाली पुस्तकों की संख्या 150 से घटकर 120 हो जाती है। 6000 में खरीदी जा सकने वाली पुस्तकों की संख्या और पुस्तक की कीमत के बीच संबंध क्या है?

mr.stem: जर एका पुस्तकाच्या किंमतीत 40 ते 50 पर्यंत वाढ होत असेल, तर 6000 ला खरेदी करू शकणाऱ्या पुस्तकांची संख्या 150 ते 120 पर्यंत कमी होते. पुस्तकाच्या किंमतीचा आणि खरेदी करू शकणाऱ्या पुस्तकांच्या संख्येचा संबंध काय असतो?
mr.solution: संबंध व्यस्त प्रमाण आहे, कारण पुस्तकाच्या किंमतीत वाढ होऊन निश्चित रकमेत खरेदी करू शकणाऱ्या पुस्तकांची संख्या कमी होते. हे खालील तथ्याने पुष्टीत आहे की किंमत आणि प्रमाणाचा गुणाकार अचल राहतो (40×150 = 50×120 = 6000). प्रत्यक्ष प्रमाणाचा अर्थ दोन्ही मूल्यांची एकत्र वाढ होते, जे येथे नाही. कोणतेही प्रमाण नाही किंवा निश्चित करता येत नाही हे चुकीचे आहे कारण संबंध अचल गुणाकाराद्वारे स्पष्टपणे निश्चित केला गेला आहे.
